lines.en: Why did Hugh's diet not work?
lines.cn: 为什么休的节食计划没有效果呢？

lines.en: My friend, Hugh, has always been fat,
lines.cn: 我的朋友休一直都很胖。

lines.en: but things got so bad recently that he decided to go on a diet.
lines.cn: 但最近情况变得非常糟糕，以至于他决定开始节食。

lines.en: He began his diet a week ago.
First of all, he wrote out a long list of all the foods which were forbidden.
lines.cn: 首先，他列出了一份长长的清单，上面列出了所有被禁止食用的食物。

lines.en: The list included most of the things Hugh loves:
lines.cn: 这份清单上列出了休最喜欢的大多数东西。

lines.en: butter, potatoes, rice, beer, milk, chocolate, and sweets.
lines.cn: 黄油、土豆、米饭、啤酒、牛奶、巧克力和甜点。

lines.en: Yesterday I paid him a visit.
I rang the bell and was not surprised to see that Hugh was still as fat as ever.
lines.cn: 我按响了门铃，看到休还是和以前一样胖，并没有感到惊讶。

lines.en: He led me into his room and hurriedly hid a large parcel under his desk.
lines.cn: 他把我带进了他的房间，然后匆忙地把一个大包裹藏在了桌子下面。

lines.en: It was obvious that he was very embarrassed.
lines.cn: 很明显，他感到非常尴尬。

lines.en: When I asked him what he was doing,
lines.cn: 当我问他正在做什么时，

lines.en: he smiled guiltily and then put the parcel on the desk.
lines.cn: 他带着内疚的笑容，把包裹放在了桌子上。

lines.en: He explained that his diet was so strict that he had to reward himself occasionally.
lines.cn: 他解释说，他的饮食控制非常严格，因此偶尔需要奖励自己一下。

lines.en: Then he showed me the contents of the parcel.
lines.cn: 然后他向我展示了包裹里的物品。

lines.en: It contained five large bars of chocolate and three bags of sweets!
lines.cn: 里面装有五块大巧克力和三袋糖果！
